title: pilosella brachiata subsp. leptocomoides
intro: Pilosella brachiata subsp. leptocomoides, commonly known as Alpine Buttercup, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, such as constipation and diarrhea, and its anti-inflammatory properties may help alleviate symptoms of rheumatism and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella brachiata subsp. leptocomoides include its ability to stimulate digestion, act as a diuretic, and exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
